items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I played in the background music in that picture, with Rosalind Russell.

ctx.x: You were mentioning also another film that you were in that's not listed in the book, and that's Gypsy. Isn't that right?

Oh, I played in the background music in that picture, with Rosalind Russell. The thing that stands out in my mind about that is that Rosalind Russell actually sang some of the songs. You know, she wasn't really a singer, and so we probably did about 46 takes on one thing that she did, and they pieced it together, and you know, they do marvelous...they do magic with the scissors out in the studios -- so she came over just great. I saw it... The picture was on the other night, in the Natalie Wood series that was…
Were there other Jazz musicians on that film?
